description: This bar chart illustrates the effect scores for different linguistic tags across several models. The horizontal axis represents the categories “gender,” “number,” “tag,” and “tense,” listed in that order, while the vertical axis represents the effect score, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at 5, 10, 15, and 20. For each category, there are three bars representing different models: XLM-Base (light blue), XLM-RoBERTa (red), and XLM-DeBERTa (dark green). Each bar includes error bars extending above and below the main bar segment. The bars are grouped by category, with each model represented side-by-side within each group. For the “gender” category, the XLM-Base bar extends to approximately 17, the XLM-RoBERTa bar to approximately 19, and the XLM-DeBERTa bar to approximately 18. For the “tense” category, the XLM-Base bar extends to approximately 11, the XLM-RoBERTa bar to approximately 16, and the XLM-DeBERTa bar to approximately 17. The bars are not sorted by any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
